setting: After an awkward text exchange, a couple finally talks face to face at home.
lyrics:
Said I love you, said I love you
Said I love you, said I love you

Face to face
I'm looking at you in a secret place
Undress the words so we say nothing fake
It's so much better when our words are naked
We don't need space
I wanna hold you tight again
For us to feel each others hearts at the “right place”
I guess this is why God made us like this

Songs sound amazing with you
Views lose their beauty without you
It feels like I don't exist without you baby
Without you baby
Without you baby

I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking
I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
Love you love you I said I love you

I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”

I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
Love you
My body's talking to you

Touch my hair
Your lips stroke my lips
When we share these beautiful moments
How I dare myself to love you
I'm reminiscing time after time
Missing your caress
It makes me feel high again
Naturally addicted to your effects
It's like a “love drug”
I guess this is why God made your hands like this

Everytime I'm clothed in your warmth
I can see many aspects of you in me
It feels like I'm so empty without you baby
Without you baby
Without you baby

I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking
I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you
Love you love you I said I love you

I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking
I said I love you, said I love you, said I love you, love you
My body's talking to you

Images in my mind are melodies
Inside of you I find our harmonies
I wish I could rewind this song beyond my memories
Over and over......
Ooh...

I still can't find any other words than “I Love You”
Let our bodies do the talking
My body's talking to you

lyricConnections.explanationJa: 「直接会って」。メッセージでは伝わりにくい話をするときに使える。
「言葉が見つからない」。気持ちをうまく表現できないときに使える。
「何度も繰り返して」。同じことを何度もしたときに使える。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Can we talk face to face for a minute?
I don't want another message to come across the wrong way.

conversation.japanese: 少し直接話せる？　またメッセージで誤解されたくないんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Yeah. When you went quiet earlier, I thought you were upset with me.

conversation.japanese: うん。さっき急に黙ったから、私に怒っているのかと思った。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I kept typing and deleting because I couldn't find the words.

conversation.japanese: 怒っていたわけじゃない。何て言えばいいかわからなくて、打っては消していたんだ。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Then don't worry about saying it perfectly.
Just tell me what was on your mind.

conversation.japanese: それなら、完璧に言おうとしなくていいよ。思っていたことをそのまま聞かせて。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I know I've said it over and over, but I really mean it.

conversation.japanese: 会いたかった。何度も言っているけど、本当にそう思ってる。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I missed you too. Come sit with me.

conversation.japanese: 私も会いたかった。こっちに来て、隣に座って。
